name: Raptor-Vita-Port
description: Raptor Vita Port is a native PS Vita port of *Raptor: Call of the Shadows*.
long_description: Raptor Vita Port is a native PS Vita port of *Raptor: Call of the Shadows*. It is based on the open-source, reverse-engineered source port **skynettx/raptor** (itself based on the reverse-engineered codebase by nukeykt), licensed under the GPL-2.0.
